resources.string: Winlator-style buttons, sticks and D-pads on top of any app you pick (emulators, games). Shown only when that app is open.
Game buttons that float over any app you choose (Winlator, emulators, games). They show up by themselves when the game opens.
Accessibility: ONA overlay (best: instant app detection + touch output)
Usage access (backup app detection if accessibility is off)
Run in the background and show the controls over the chosen apps
No apps yet. Add an emulator or a game.
This file is not an ONA controls profile

Letter keys, ESC, Enter, Shift… go to the app in front like a keyboard (Android 13+). Buttons set to TAP touch their point, TOUCH_DRAG sticks move the app\'s own stick. Needs the accessibility switch.
Keys, mouse and gamepad sent over Wi-Fi to pc-bridge/ona_bridge.py on the PC.
Keys and taps into any app with su (input keyevent / tap). Needs a rooted phone.

App detection uses the accessibility event that Android sends only when a window changes: no polling, no wake-ups. Without accessibility, usage access is read once per second and only while the screen is on. Controls redraw only while touched; each control is its own small window, so the rest of the screen goes straight to the app.

Lets ONA Controls show your floating controls when the app you picked is opened (it only looks at which app is in front), press keys in that app like a keyboard, and touch it for buttons you set to TAP. It does not read screen content.
Allow \"Draw over other apps\" for ONA first
Tap the spot on the app that this control should touch
Keys (second one is optional, pressed together)
Keys for KEYS output (up, right, down, left)
Shizuku: letter keys in ANY app (no root)
Install Shizuku, start it with Wireless debugging, then allow ONA Controls here.
Keys can\'t reach this app. In ONA Controls set up Shizuku (Permissions).
Quick start (do the steps in order)
Needed so the buttons can be drawn over the game.
Finds out when your game is open, so the buttons appear and hide by themselves.
The buttons appear only over the apps you add here.
Then open your game: the buttons appear by themselves.
In the editor: drag a button to move it, pinch to resize, ⚙ for keys, colour, width and height.
The blue ONA button: menu (edit layout, change profile, hide / show, stop).
The eye button under it: one tap hides all buttons so you can reach the game under them, another tap brings them back.
Edit layout: drag buttons, pinch to resize, + adds a button, ⚙ changes the selected one, ✓ saves.
In a button\'s ⚙: keys (two keys = pressed together, like CTRL+H), colour, size, width, height, toggle.
If a key does nothing: open Shizuku and press Start (it stops when the phone restarts).
Drag the ONA button and the eye button to place them anywhere.
